events.title: Last year's FA Cup runners-up 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 win 2–1 at home to 크리스털 팰리스 in the third round. 리즈 유나이티드 are held to a goalless draw at Conference side Rushden & Diamonds .
맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 미들즈브러 3–1 in the FA Cup third round at Old Trafford.
아스널 begin their defence of the FA Cup by beating 프레스턴 노스 엔드 2–0 in the third round at Deepdale .

노팅엄 포리스트, bottom of the Premier League and winless for 17 games, sack manager Dave Bassett after less than two years in charge. Micky Adams , former 스완지 시티 and 브렌트퍼드 manager, is placed in temporary charge of Forest.
15-year-old 노츠 카운티 schoolboy forward 저메인 페넌트 signs for 아스널's academy in a £2 million deal.

The first Premier League games of 1999 include 코번트리 시티's 4–0 home win over 노팅엄 포리스트 – the 18th successive league game that the visitors have failed to win. 사우샘프턴 beat fellow relegation strugglers 찰턴 애슬레틱 3–1 at The Dell .
Ron Atkinson is appointed manager of 노팅엄 포리스트 until the end of the season.
리즈 유나이티드 avoid what would have been one of the biggest FA Cup upsets of modern times and beat Rushden and Diamonds 3–1 in the third round replay at Elland Road.
윔블던 pay a club record £7.5 million for 웨스트햄 유나이티드 striker John Hartson , who six months ago was a transfer target for 맨체스터 유나이티드.

Two high scoring games in the Premier League sees Dwight Yorke and Robbie Fowler score hat tricks for their respective clubs as 맨체스터 유나이티드 thrash 레스터 시티 6–2 at Filbert Street , while 리버풀 crush 사우샘프턴 7–1 at Anfield.
Bryan Kidd boosts his 블랙번 로버스 side in their battle against relegation by signing 크리스털 팰리스 striker Matt Jansen for £4.1 million.
애스턴 빌라 suffer a shock FA Cup exit at home to Division Two leaders 풀럼 in the fourth round.
Two late goals see 맨체스터 유나이티드 overturn 리버풀's 1–0 lead and win 2–1 in the fourth round tie at Old Trafford.
Cash-strapped Division One strugglers 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 hold 첼시 to an impressive 1–1 draw at the Manor Ground .
Two midfielders change clubs for £4 million – Marc-Vivien Foé from Lens to 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and Jason McAteer from 리버풀 to 블랙번 로버스.
Steve McManaman agrees to sign for 레알 마드리드 from 리버풀 at the end of the season.

Glenn Hoddle appears in an interview in The Sunday Times in which he suggests that disabled people are paying for their sins in a previous life. 노팅엄 포리스트 end their 19-match winless run in the league with a 1–0 away win over 에버턴.

January ends with 맨체스터 유나이티드 now top of the Premier League, but former leaders 애스턴 빌라 still only a point behind bracketed on points with 첼시. 아스널, meanwhile, have crept into the title frame and now stand fourth – just two points off the top. 웨스트햄 유나이티드's challenge has crumbled and they now stand ninth, with 11 points separating them from top spot. 노팅엄 포리스트, meanwhile, have gone from bad to worse and now prop up the table. They are joined in the drop zone by 사우샘프턴 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 after Brian Kidd guided 블랙번 로버스 out of the bottom three. 선덜랜드 and 브래드퍼드 시티 lead the way in Division One, with 볼턴 원더러스, 입스위치 타운, 왓퍼드 and 버밍엄 시티 completing the top six. 그림즈비 타운 are back in form and giving the top six a serious run for their money.
